run_release_docs: run the release_docs.py script with a version number to branch Google Test/Mock wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare wiki file branching for googletest or googlemock
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to copy unversioned wiki pages to versioned copies via svn cp
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update links in branched wiki files using WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to rewrite internal wiki links to the versioned prefix
dropwiki_DropWikiSuffix: drop the .wiki suffix from a filename using DropWikiSuffix to get the base page name for regex link matching
